integrity: The proof is reconstructed from the exact Pitman–Yor one-step partition rule and exchangeability. An independent exact-arithmetic enumeration of set partitions through size eight verifies the conditional gap, pair-homozygosity covariance, and sample-homozygosity conversion.
scientific_limitations: The model is the standard two-parameter Pitman–Yor exchangeable partition with 0 <= alpha < 1 and theta > -alpha.
The result concerns finite-sample partition statistics, not latent population-frequency diversity functionals.
The identity is second-moment/conditional-mean information and does not establish a full stochastic ordering.
title: Exact richness–Simpson covariance under Pitman–Yor sampling
